goal: Integrate multi-source Takeout ingestion for Google Photos (streaming sidecars/EXIF), Google Maps Reviews/Saved Places, and CLIP visual vector embeddings without external photos frontend, and update README without throat clearing

steps.description: Clean repository filesystem, add comprehensive .gitignore, and untrack large personal databases and private exports
Generalize configuration, server, APIs, and scripts using environment variables and generic defaults, eliminating hardcoded user paths and account identifiers
Provide database schema initialization script and anonymized demo dataset generator for instant out-of-the-box local execution
Ensure hermetic test suite and API contract auditor pass cleanly with zero dependency on personal database
Author comprehensive system architecture specification, implementation guide, and data model documentation for other implementers
Author GitHub-ready README, Quickstart guide, and update pyproject.toml package metadata
Scrub large binary blobs from git history for GitHub 100MB limit compliance and perform full verification
Implement photo corpus ingestion engine for Google Photos Takeout (streaming ZIP and loose directory with JSON sidecars, EXIF, and preview generator) without external photos frontend
Enhance universal Takeout importer and tests for multi-stream Takeout ingestion (Location History, Google Photos, Maps Reviews, Saved Places)
Update docs/ARCHITECTURE.md and README.md with comprehensive multi-stream Takeout documentation
Implement visual vector embeddings architecture and strip throat clearing from README
Capture privacy-verified screenshots for documentation (Arches National Park, Yucatan flight, Universal Search) excluding all personal homes and people
Push sanitized codebase, documentation, and screenshots to GitHub remote origin main
